title: S-A: reefer failure, rule-decided re-route, dual approval
description: A compressor fault on Sierra Cold Freight's trailer warms a tier-A organic lot. Detection opens the case unprompted; the engine scores five options against doing nothing; a rule decides the re-route to Bayline (no AI). Policy v1 requires Sales and Quality; the gateway then writes to SAP, the TMS and the carrier. Numbers are the design's illustrative worked example.

decision_rights.note: Food-safety flagged product may only be held, inspected or disposed.
Selling a lot to a different customer above $25k.
Any change to a tier-A customer commitment.
Filing a claim is an external legal step.
An AI-chosen recovery above $10k never self-executes.
An AI-chosen settlement above $10k never self-executes.
Otherwise the autonomy thresholds decide (L3 automatic vs L4 approval).

analyst.question: Which lots have less than 10 days of shelf life left?

answer.question: Which lots have less than 10 days of shelf life left?
answer.interpretation: Lots whose remaining shelf life, as of their last reading, is below 10 days.
answer.sql: SELECT * FROM SEMANTIC_VIEW(BBC_OS.SEM.EXCURSION_RECOVERY DIMENSIONS lots.lot_id, products.variety METRICS lot_thermal.remaining_shelf_life_days) WHERE remaining_shelf_life_days < 10 ORDER BY remaining_shelf_life_days
suggestions: Which carriers held lots during breaches today?

analyst.question: What share of excess shelf-life loss did each holder cause on lot L-A?

answer.question: What share of excess shelf-life loss did each holder cause on lot L-A?
answer.interpretation: For lot L-A, each custody holder's share of the lot's attributable excess shelf-life loss.
answer.sql: SELECT * FROM SEMANTIC_VIEW(BBC_OS.SEM.EXCURSION_RECOVERY DIMENSIONS holders.holder_name, holders.holder_type METRICS custody_exposure.excess_life_share, custody_exposure.thermal_exposure_deg_h) WHERE lot_id = 'L-A'
